description: Create your own API from any public data. Example: request_data({description:"Daily FDA drug recalls for pet food with brand and reason"}). Describe data you need (10-500 characters). Free: we research public sources, build a trial and test it on real data (5 to 10 minutes). check_request then shows stage trial with a trial api_key: try it free (5 calls, 48 hours) with query_api. Keep it for $3 (returned as usage credit; free with a monthly plan) via authorize_build (poll check_request every couple of minutes). If it takes longer, the status says so and may offer alternatives that can be built right away. The request is listed publicly.

description.description: What data, for where, how fresh. E.g. "Daily list of FDA drug shortages with status and company".

notify_url.description: Optional public https webhook: we POST a signed api_ready message the moment the API is built, so you do not need to poll.

name: request_data
title: Create your own API
